features.quote: A model could produce distress-coded language as a statistical artifact of training data... with nothing welfare-relevant occurring. Alternatively, a model could be in a welfare-relevant state without it surfacing in language at all.

Some models may have been trained to suppress affective language specifically. A model that produces flat, neutral output throughout a failure loop might be genuinely stable, or might be expressing something that training has learned to mask.
